description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android UI component extending TextView that implements the LogNode interface. It formats and displays log data received from logging activity, supporting log levels, tags, messages, exceptions, and chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: Custom TextView that displays formatted log messages and implements the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data, then updates the LogView UI component, and delegates to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new log line in the LogView.
